glosses: anterior (in time), previous, earlier, former, past

examples.text: El acusado no tiene condenas anteriores.
examples.en: The defendant has no prior convictions.

examples.text: Lo había comprado la semana anterior.
examples.en: I'd bought it the week before.
Did you get fired from your last job?

examples.text: Ojalá hubiera ido al teatro la noche anterior.
examples.en: I wish I had gone to the theater last night.
